shared_elements: human figure (head with hair/headdress rendered in relief)
carved relief lines/curved motifs on a stone surface
justification: The only real correspondence is that both surfaces include a human form rendered in relief with a distinct headdress/hairline treatment, which is about as generic as iconographic overlap gets. A shows a horizontal narrative procession of profile human attendants leading horned rams with detailed fleece, hands, garments and a floral border, while B is a frontal/rear monumental figure whose back bears isolated abstract motifs (concentric discs, arcs, a broad band), with no animals, no narrative and no linear composition.
